```{r}
ALLOWED_PLATFORMS<-c("GPL96","GPL570")
# =========================================================
# DATASET-SPECIFIC OVERRIDES
# =========================================================
DATASET_OVERRIDES <- list(

  GSE10810 = list(
    label_col     = "characteristics_ch1.6",
    normal_val_rx = ":\\s*s\\s*$",
    cancer_val_rx = ":\\s*t\\s*$"
  ),

  GSE15852 = list(
    label_col     = "source_name_ch1",
    normal_val_rx = "^normal breast tissue$",
    cancer_val_rx = "^breast tumor tissue$"
  ),

  GSE25066 = list(
  label_col     = "characteristics_ch1.20",
  normal_val_rx = "pam50_class:\\s*normal",
  cancer_val_rx = "pam50_class:\\s*(basal|luma|lumb|her2)"
  # no subtype storage
),

  GSE29044 = list(
    force_platform    = "GPL570",
    exclude_tissue_rx = "whole blood",
    label_col         = "type:ch1",
    normal_val_rx     = "^normal$",
    cancer_val_rx     = "^(idc|dcis)$"
  ),

  GSE29431 = list(

  ),

  GSE42568 = list(
    label_col     = "characteristics_ch1",
    normal_val_rx = "tissue: normal breast",
    cancer_val_rx = "tissue: breast cancer"
  ),

  GSE45827 = list(
    label_col     = "characteristics_ch1",
    normal_val_rx = "diagnosis:\\s*none|none \\(normal\\)",
    cancer_val_rx = "diagnosis:\\s*breast cancer"
  ),

  GSE54002 = list(
    label_col     = "characteristics_ch1",
    normal_val_rx = "non-tumor",
    cancer_val_rx = "^tumor/nontumor: tumor$"
  ),

  GSE65194 = list(
    skip_global_cell_filter = TRUE,
    skip_fallback_for_na    = TRUE,
    label_col               = "characteristics_ch1",
    normal_val_rx           = "sample_group:\\s*healthy",
    cancer_val_rx           = "sample_group:\\s*(tnbc|her2|luminal)"
  ),

  GSE7904 = list(

# =========================================================
# GEO LOADER
# =========================================================
load_geo_eset <- function(gse_id) {

  cache_dir <- file.path("data", "geo-cache")
  if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  ovr <- DATASET_OVERRIDES[[gse_id]]

  g <- tryCatch(
    GEOquery::getGEO(gse_id, destdir = cache_dir, GSEMatrix = TRUE),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(g, "error")) {
    f <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(gse_id, "_series_matrix.txt.gz"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing GEO file: ", gse_id)
    g <- GEOquery::getGEO(filename = f)
  }

  if (inherits(g, "ExpressionSet")) return(g)

  if (is.list(g)) {
    plats <- sapply(g, annotation)
    message(gse_id, ": found platforms: ", paste(plats, collapse = ", "))

    if (!is.null(ovr$force_platform)) {
      idx <- which(plats == ovr$force_platform)
      if (length(idx) == 0)
        stop(gse_id, ": forced platform ", ovr$force_platform,
             " not found. Available: ", paste(plats, collapse = ", "))
      message(gse_id, ": selected forced platform ", ovr$force_platform)
      return(g[[idx[1]]])
    }

    idx <- which(plats %in% ALLOWED_PLATFORMS)
    if (length(idx) == 0) stop(gse_id, ": no allowed platform found")
    return(g[[idx[1]]])
  }

  stop("Failed to load ExpressionSet for ", gse_id)
}

# =========================================================
# REMOVE DUPLICATE SAMPLES
# =========================================================
remove_duplicates <- function(eset, gse_id) {
  dups <- duplicated(sampleNames(eset))
  if (any(dups)) {
    message(gse_id, ": removing ", sum(dups), " duplicate GSM IDs")
    eset <- eset[, !dups]
  }
  eset
}

# =========================================================
# FILTER NON-BIOLOGICAL SAMPLES
# =========================================================
filter_samples <- function(eset, gse_id) {

  pd  <- pData(eset)
  ovr <- DATASET_OVERRIDES[[gse_id]]

  make_text <- function(cols) {
    if (length(cols) == 0) return(rep("", nrow(pd)))
    apply(pd[, cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x)
      tolower(paste(as.character(x), collapse = " "))
    )
  }

  full_text <- make_text(colnames(pd))

  cell_rx <- paste0(
    "(\\bcell line\\b|\\bmcf-?7\\b|\\bmcf10a\\b|\\bmcf12a\\b|",
    "t47d|bt474|skbr3|hek293|hela|\\batcc\\b|",
    "\\borganoid\\b|zr-75|184b5|bt-?549|\\bbt20\\b|",
    "mda-mb-|hs 578t)"
  )
  if (!is.null(ovr$skip_global_cell_filter) && ovr$skip_global_cell_filter) {
    is_cell <- rep(FALSE, nrow(pd))
    message(gse_id, ": skipping global cell-line filter (handled via label_col)")
  } else {
    is_cell <- grepl(cell_rx, full_text, perl = TRUE)
  }

  blood_rx <- "(\\bpbmc\\b|\\bserum\\b|\\bplasma\\b|lymphocyte|buffy coat|peripheral blood)"
  is_blood <- grepl(blood_rx, full_text, perl = TRUE)

  bad_rx <- "(fibroblast|\\bneuron\\b|hepatocyte|\\bcolon\\b|\\bovarian\\b|\\bprostate\\b)"
  is_bad <- grepl(bad_rx, full_text, perl = TRUE)

  is_tissue_bad <- rep(FALSE, nrow(pd))
  if (!is.null(ovr$exclude_tissue_rx)) {
    tissue_cols <- grep("tissue", colnames(pd), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(tissue_cols) > 0) {
      tissue_text   <- make_text(tissue_cols)
      is_tissue_bad <- grepl(ovr$exclude_tissue_rx, tissue_text, perl = TRUE)
    }
  }

  is_title_bad <- rep(FALSE, nrow(pd))
  if (!is.null(ovr$exclude_title_rx) && "title" %in% colnames(pd)) {
    is_title_bad <- grepl(ovr$exclude_title_rx,
                          tolower(as.character(pd[["title"]])), perl = TRUE)
  }

  keep <- !(is_cell | is_blood | is_bad | is_tissue_bad | is_title_bad)

  message(gse_id,
          " | removed: cell=",      sum(is_cell),
          " blood=",                sum(is_blood),
          " off-target=",           sum(is_bad),
          " tissue-specific=",      sum(is_tissue_bad),
          " title-specific=",       sum(is_title_bad),
          " | kept=",               sum(keep))

  eset[, keep]
}

# =========================================================
# LOG TRANSFORM
# =========================================================
check_and_log_transform <- function(eset) {
  e     <- exprs(eset)
  e_fin <- e[is.finite(e)]
  if (length(e_fin) == 0) return(eset)
  if (quantile(e_fin, 0.99) > 50) {
    message("  log2 transform applied")
    e[e <= 0] <- NA
    e[is.na(e)] <- min(e, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
    exprs(eset) <- log2(e)
  }
  eset
}

# =========================================================
# PROBE -> GENE COLLAPSE
# =========================================================
collapse_to_genes <- function(eset) {
  e   <- exprs(eset)
  fd  <- fData(eset)

  sym_col <- grep("gene.?symbol|^symbol$", colnames(fd),
                  ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  genes <- if (!is.na(sym_col)) fd[[sym_col]] else rownames(e)

  genes <- sapply(genes, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || trimws(as.character(x)) %in% c("", "---"))
      return(NA_character_)
    strsplit(as.character(x), " /// ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
  })
  empty         <- is.na(genes) | trimws(genes) == ""
  genes[empty]  <- rownames(e)[empty]

  e_g <- limma::avereps(e, ID = genes)
  list(eMat_g = e_g, pMat = pData(eset))
}

# =========================================================
# LABEL INFERENCE
# =========================================================
infer_binary_label <- function(pMat, gse_id = "") {

  ovr <- DATASET_OVERRIDES[[gse_id]]
  n   <- nrow(pMat)
  label <- rep(NA_character_, n)

  if (!is.null(ovr$label_col)) {
    col <- ovr$label_col
    if (col %in% colnames(pMat)) {
      vals      <- tolower(trimws(as.character(pMat[[col]])))
      is_normal <- grepl(ovr$normal_val_rx, vals, perl = TRUE)
      is_cancer <- if (!is.null(ovr$cancer_val_rx))
        grepl(ovr$cancer_val_rx, vals, perl = TRUE) else rep(FALSE, n)

      label[is_normal & !is_cancer] <- "Normal"
      label[is_cancer]              <- "Cancer"

      message(gse_id, ": label_col '", col,
              "' -> Normal=", sum(label == "Normal", na.rm = TRUE),
              " Cancer=",    sum(label == "Cancer", na.rm = TRUE),
              " NA=",        sum(is.na(label)))
    } else {
      warning(gse_id, ": label_col '", col, "' not found in pData")
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(ovr$normal_title_rx) && "title" %in% colnames(pMat)) {
    titles      <- tolower(as.character(pMat[["title"]]))
    is_normal_t <- grepl(ovr$normal_title_rx, titles, perl = TRUE)
    is_cancer_t <- grepl(ovr$cancer_title_rx, titles, perl = TRUE)
    label[is_normal_t & is.na(label)] <- "Normal"
    label[is_cancer_t & is.na(label)] <- "Cancer"
    message(gse_id, ": title matching -> Normal=",
            sum(label == "Normal", na.rm = TRUE),
            " Cancer=", sum(label == "Cancer", na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  skip_fallback <- !is.null(ovr$skip_fallback_for_na) && ovr$skip_fallback_for_na
  still_na      <- is.na(label)

  if (any(still_na) && !skip_fallback) {
    normal_rx <- paste0(
      "(\\bnormal\\b|\\bhealthy\\b|\\bcontrol\\b|",
      "adjacent.?normal|reduction mammoplasty|",
      "non[- ]tumo[ur]+|nontumou?r|\\bbenign\\b)"
    )
    cancer_rx <- paste0(
      "(\\bcancer\\b|\\btumou?r\\b|carcinoma|\\bmalignant\\b|",
      "\\binvasive\\b|\\bductal\\b|\\blobular\\b|",
      "\\bher2\\b|\\bluminal\\b|\\bbasal\\b|\\bIDC\\b|\\bILC\\b)"
    )
    pri_cols <- grep(
      "characteristics|source_name|title|tissue|disease|type|group",
      colnames(pMat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE
    )
    na_rows  <- which(still_na)
    pri_sub  <- apply(pMat[na_rows, pri_cols, drop = FALSE], 1,
                      function(x) tolower(paste(as.character(x), collapse = " ")))
    full_sub <- apply(pMat[na_rows, , drop = FALSE], 1,
                      function(x) tolower(paste(as.character(x), collapse = " ")))

    has_n <- grepl(normal_rx, pri_sub,  perl = TRUE)
    has_c <- grepl(cancer_rx, pri_sub,  perl = TRUE) |
             grepl(cancer_rx, full_sub, perl = TRUE)

    label[na_rows[has_n & !has_c]] <- "Normal"
    label[na_rows[has_c]]          <- "Cancer"
    message(gse_id, ": fallback resolved ",
            sum(!is.na(label[na_rows])), " of ", length(na_rows), " NA rows")
  } else if (any(still_na) && skip_fallback) {
    message(gse_id, ": fallback SKIPPED -- ",
            sum(still_na), " NA rows will be dropped")
  }

  label <- factor(label, levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))
  message("\n", gse_id, " LABEL SUMMARY:")
  print(table(label, useNA = "always"))

  list(label = label, method = "column_targeted_v9")
}

# =========================================================
# EXTRACT SUBTYPE
# =========================================================
extract_subtype <- function(pMat, ovr) {
  col <- ovr$subtype_col
  if (is.null(col) || !(col %in% colnames(pMat)))
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(pMat)))

  raw    <- tolower(trimws(as.character(pMat[[col]])))
  prefix <- ovr$subtype_val_prefix

  if (!is.null(prefix)) {
    cleaned <- sub(prefix, "", raw, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  } else {
    cleaned <- raw
  }
  paste0(toupper(substr(cleaned, 1, 1)), substr(cleaned, 2, nchar(cleaned)))
}

# =========================================================
# CLASS VALIDATION
# =========================================================
validate_classes <- function(label, min_per_class = 5) {
  tab     <- table(label, useNA = "no")
  has_both   <- all(c("Cancer", "Normal") %in% names(tab))
  sufficient <- has_both && all(tab[c("Cancer", "Normal")] >= min_per_class)
  sufficient
}

# =========================================================
# FULL PIPELINE
# =========================================================
process_gse <- function(id) {

  message("\n====================")
  message("Processing ", id)
  message("====================")

  ovr  <- DATASET_OVERRIDES[[id]]
  eset <- load_geo_eset(id)
  eset <- remove_duplicates(eset, id)
  eset <- filter_samples(eset, id)

  if (ncol(eset) < 10) stop(id, ": too few samples after filtering")

  eset <- check_and_log_transform(eset)
  cc   <- collapse_to_genes(eset)
  lab  <- infer_binary_label(cc$pMat, id)

  meta         <- cc$pMat
  meta$Status  <- as.character(lab$label)
  meta$dataset <- id
  meta$sample_id <- rownames(meta)

  keep <- !is.na(meta$Status)

  is_all_cancer <- !is.null(ovr$label_col) &&
    all(meta$Status[keep] == "Cancer", na.rm = TRUE) &&
    sum(meta$Status[keep] == "Normal", na.rm = TRUE) == 0

  if (is_all_cancer) {
    message(id, ": single-class Cancer dataset retained by design")
  } else {
    if (!validate_classes(lab$label))
      stop(id, ": failed class validation")
  }

  list(
    id   = id,
    expr = cc$eMat_g[, keep, drop = FALSE],
    meta = meta[keep, ]
  )
}

# =========================================================
# AUDIT
# =========================================================
audit_results <- function(pieces, dataset_ids, overrides) {

  message("\n", strrep("=", 55))
  message("AUDIT SUMMARY")
  message(strrep("=", 55))

  rows <- lapply(dataset_ids, function(id) {
    p   <- pieces[[id]]
    ovr <- overrides[[id]]

    if (is.null(p)) {
      return(data.frame(dataset  = id, status = "FAILED",
                        n_total  = NA_integer_, n_cancer = NA_integer_,
                        n_normal = NA_integer_,
                        note     = "FAILED: check error messages above",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }

    tab      <- table(p$meta$Status)
    n_cancer <- as.integer(tab["Cancer"]); n_cancer[is.na(n_cancer)] <- 0L
    n_normal <- as.integer(tab["Normal"]); n_normal[is.na(n_normal)] <- 0L
    n_total  <- ncol(p$expr)

    status <- if (n_normal == 0 && n_cancer > 0) {
      "CANCER_ONLY_BY_DESIGN"
    } else if (n_cancer == 0 || n_normal == 0) {
      "SINGLE_CLASS_WARNING"
    } else {
      "OK"
    }

    note <- if (status == "CANCER_ONLY_BY_DESIGN") {
      sub_tab <- if ("Subtype" %in% colnames(p$meta))
        paste(names(table(p$meta$Subtype)),
              table(p$meta$Subtype), sep = "=", collapse = " | ")
      else ""
      paste0("Tumour-only cohort. Subtypes: ", sub_tab)
    } else {
      paste0(n_cancer, "C / ", n_normal, "N")
    }

    data.frame(dataset = id, status = status, n_total = n_total,
               n_cancer = n_cancer, n_normal = n_normal,
               note = note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  tbl <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(tbl) <- NULL
  print(tbl, row.names = FALSE)

  problems <- tbl[!tbl$status %in% c("OK", "CANCER_ONLY_BY_DESIGN"), ]
  if (nrow(problems) > 0) {
    message("\n--- ACTION REQUIRED ---")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(problems)))
      message(problems$dataset[i], " [", problems$status[i], "]: ", problems$note[i])
  } else {
    message("\nAll datasets passed.")
  }
  invisible(tbl)
}

# =========================================================
# QUANTILE NORMALISE
# =========================================================
quantile_normalise <- function(expr) {
  limma::normalizeBetweenArrays(expr, method = "quantile")
}

# =========================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# =========================================================
dataset_ids <- c(
  "GSE10810", "GSE29044",
  "GSE29431", "GSE42568", "GSE45827", "GSE54002",
  "GSE65194", "GSE7904"
)

pieces <- list()
for (id in dataset_ids) {
  pieces[[id]] <- tryCatch(
    process_gse(id),
    error = function(e) {
      message("FAILED ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

pieces <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pieces)
message("\nDONE: ", length(pieces), " datasets retained")

audit_tbl <- audit_results(pieces, dataset_ids, DATASET_OVERRIDES)

# =========================================================
# MERGE
# =========================================================
all_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(pieces, function(x) rownames(x$expr)))
cat("\nGenes shared across all datasets:", length(all_genes), "\n")

pad_to_genes <- function(e, genes) {
  miss <- setdiff(genes, rownames(e))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    pad <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(miss), ncol = ncol(e),
                  dimnames = list(miss, colnames(e)))
    e   <- rbind(e, pad)
  }
  e[genes, , drop = FALSE]
}

merged_expr <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pieces, function(x)
  pad_to_genes(x$expr, all_genes)
))

master_meta <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pieces, function(x) {
  m <- x$meta
  data.frame(
    sample_id = rownames(m),
    dataset   = m$dataset,
    Status    = m$Status,
    Subtype   = if ("Subtype" %in% colnames(m)) m$Subtype else NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(master_meta) <- master_meta$sample_id

cat("\nMerged matrix:", nrow(merged_expr), "genes x", ncol(merged_expr), "samples\n")
cat("\nSamples per dataset:\n")
print(table(master_meta$dataset, master_meta$Status, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SAVE QUANTILE-NORMALISED DATASETS
# =========================================================

dir.create("data/normalised", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

normalised_pieces <- list()

for (id in names(pieces)) {
  expr_q <- quantile_normalise(pieces[[id]]$expr)
  meta   <- pieces[[id]]$meta
  normalised_pieces[[id]] <- list(id = id, expr = expr_q, meta = meta)
  saveRDS(
    normalised_pieces[[id]],
    file = file.path("data/normalised", paste0(id, "_normalised.rds")),
    compress = "xz"
  )
  message("Saved: ", id,
          " | genes=", nrow(expr_q),
          " | samples=", ncol(expr_q),
          " | Cancer=", sum(meta$Status == "Cancer"),
          " | Normal=", sum(meta$Status == "Normal"))
}

merged_expr_q <- do.call(cbind, lapply(normalised_pieces, function(x)
  pad_to_genes(x$expr, all_genes)
))

saveRDS(
  list(
    expr        = merged_expr_q,
    meta        = master_meta,
    all_genes   = all_genes,
    dataset_ids = names(normalised_pieces)
  ),
  file = "data/normalised/merged_normalised.rds",
  compress = "xz"
)

message("\nAll saved. Merged matrix: ",
        nrow(merged_expr_q), " genes x ", ncol(merged_expr_q), " samples")
```

## Per-Fold ComBat Helper

```{r}
combat_fit_apply <- function(expr_train, batch_train, mod_train,
                             expr_test,  batch_test) {

  train_batches  <- unique(as.character(batch_train))
  test_batches   <- unique(as.character(batch_test))
  common_batches <- intersect(train_batches, test_batches)
  novel_test_idx <- which(!(as.character(batch_test) %in% common_batches))

  corrected_train <- tryCatch({
    ComBat(dat = expr_train, batch = batch_train, mod = mod_train,
           par.prior = TRUE, mean.only = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("ComBat failed on training fold: ", conditionMessage(e),
            "\n  Falling back to limma::removeBatchEffect.")
    limma::removeBatchEffect(expr_train, batch = batch_train, design = mod_train)
  })

  corrected_test <- tryCatch({
    batch_train_f <- factor(as.character(batch_train))
    batch_test_f  <- factor(as.character(batch_test), levels = levels(batch_train_f))

    batch_means_train <- sapply(levels(batch_train_f), function(b) {
      idx <- which(batch_train_f == b)
      if (length(idx) == 0) return(rep(0, nrow(expr_train)))
      rowMeans(expr_train[, idx, drop = FALSE])
    })
    grand_mean_train <- rowMeans(expr_train)

    expr_test_corrected <- expr_test
    for (b in levels(batch_train_f)) {
      test_in_batch <- which(as.character(batch_test_f) == b)
      if (length(test_in_batch) == 0) next
      batch_effect <- batch_means_train[, b] - grand_mean_train
      expr_test_corrected[, test_in_batch] <-
        expr_test[, test_in_batch] - batch_effect
    }

    if (length(novel_test_idx) > 0) {
      message("  Test fold contains ", length(novel_test_idx),
              " samples from unseen batches; applying mean-centering only.")
      sample_means <- colMeans(expr_test[, novel_test_idx, drop = FALSE])
      expr_test_corrected[, novel_test_idx] <-
        sweep(expr_test[, novel_test_idx, drop = FALSE], 2, sample_means, "-") +
        grand_mean_train
    }
    expr_test_corrected

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Test-fold batch correction failed: ", conditionMessage(e),
            "\n  Returning uncorrected test data.")
    expr_test
  })

  list(train = corrected_train, test = corrected_test)
}
```

## PCA Visualization and RDS Export

```{r pca-and-save}
# =========================================================
# HELPER: run PCA and return a tidy data frame
# =========================================================
run_pca_df <- function(expr_mat, meta) {

  # Median-impute NA values (visualisation only -- does not affect modelling)
  expr_imp <- expr_mat
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(expr_imp))) {
    na_idx <- is.na(expr_imp[i, ])
    if (any(na_idx))
      expr_imp[i, na_idx] <- median(expr_imp[i, !na_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Remove zero-variance genes
  rv        <- apply(expr_imp, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  expr_imp  <- expr_imp[rv > 0, ]

  pca       <- prcomp(t(expr_imp), scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp   <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

  df <- data.frame(
    PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
    sample  = rownames(pca$x),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df <- dplyr::left_join(df, meta, by = c("sample" = "sample_id"))

  list(
    df      = df,
    xlab    = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    ylab    = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
  )
}

# =========================================================
# BEFORE ComBat
# =========================================================
pca_before <- run_pca_df(merged_expression, master_metadata)

# =========================================================
# AFTER ComBat  (full-data, visualisation only)
# =========================================================
mod_viz <- model.matrix(~ Status, data = master_metadata)

expr_combat <- tryCatch(
  sva::ComBat(
    dat       = merged_expression,
    batch     = master_metadata$dataset,
    mod       = mod_viz,
    par.prior = TRUE
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    message("ComBat failed, using raw data for after-PCA visualisation.")
    merged_expression
  }
)

pca_after <- run_pca_df(expr_combat, master_metadata)

# =========================================================
# QUICK PREVIEW PLOTS
# =========================================================
study_colours <- c(
  "GSE10810" = "#E41A1C", "GSE29044" = "#377EB8",
  "GSE29431" = "#4DAF4A", "GSE42568" = "#984EA3",
  "GSE45827" = "#FF7F00", "GSE54002" = "#A65628",
  "GSE65194" = "#F781BF", "GSE7904"  = "#999999"
)
status_shapes <- c("Cancer" = 16, "Normal" = 17)

make_pca_plot <- function(df, title, xlab, ylab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = dataset, shape = Status)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = study_colours, name = "Study") +
    scale_shape_manual(values  = status_shapes,  name = "Status") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = ylab)
}

p_before <- make_pca_plot(pca_before$df, "Before ComBat",
                           pca_before$xlab, pca_before$ylab)
p_after  <- make_pca_plot(pca_after$df,  "After ComBat",
                           pca_after$xlab,  pca_after$ylab)

print(p_before / p_after)

# =========================================================
# SAVE PCA RDS FOR REPORT
# =========================================================
dir.create("RDS_Files/binary", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  list(
    before      = pca_before$df,
    after       = pca_after$df,
    xlab_before = pca_before$xlab,
    ylab_before = pca_before$ylab,
    xlab_after  = pca_after$xlab,
    ylab_after  = pca_after$ylab
  ),
  file     = "RDS_Files/binary/pca_merged_binary.rds",
  compress = "xz"
)

message("PCA RDS saved to: RDS_Files/binary/pca_merged_binary.rds")
```

## Heatmap of Top Variable Genes (Visualization Only)

```{r}
# =========================================================
# HEATMAP -- BEFORE ComBat (raw data)
# =========================================================

master_metadata <- master_metadata[colnames(merged_expression), ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(merged_expression) == rownames(master_metadata)))

ordered_indices   <- order(master_metadata$Status)
metadata_sorted   <- master_metadata[ordered_indices, ]
expression_sorted <- merged_expression[, ordered_indices]

if (any(is.na(expression_sorted))) {
  library(impute)
  expression_sorted <- impute::impute.knn(expression_sorted)$data
}

rv  <- matrixStats::rowVars(expression_sorted, na.rm = TRUE)
idx <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]

annotation_df <- metadata_sorted[, c("Status", "dataset"), drop = FALSE]

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  expression_sorted[idx, ],
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  show_colnames  = FALSE,
  main  = "Top 50 Variable Genes (BEFORE ComBat)",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 6,
  border_color = NA
)

# =========================================================
# HEATMAP -- AFTER ComBat (visualisation only)
# =========================================================

# Impute combat-corrected matrix for heatmap
expr_combat_imp <- expr_combat
for (i in seq_len(nrow(expr_combat_imp))) {
  na_idx <- is.na(expr_combat_imp[i, ])
  if (any(na_idx))
    expr_combat_imp[i, na_idx] <- median(expr_combat_imp[i, !na_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
}

master_metadata <- master_metadata[colnames(expr_combat_imp), ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_combat_imp) == rownames(master_metadata)))

ordered_indices   <- order(master_metadata$Status)
metadata_sorted   <- master_metadata[ordered_indices, ]
expression_sorted <- expr_combat_imp[, ordered_indices]

rv  <- matrixStats::rowVars(expression_sorted, na.rm = TRUE)
idx <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]

annotation_df <- metadata_sorted[, c("Status", "dataset"), drop = FALSE]

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  expression_sorted[idx, ],
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  show_colnames  = FALSE,
  main  = "Top 50 Variable Genes (AFTER ComBat)",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 6,
  border_color = NA
)
```
